description: Unapproved literature-backed candidate claims. Do not use as approved clinical knowledge or automatically enforce these interventions.

claims.statement: Pressure injury prevention planning should be based on risk and skin assessment, including mobility and the capacity to reposition.
claims.scope: Individuals assessed for pressure ulcer risk; adult guidance and age-specific sections differ.
claims.limitations: Does not establish the individual's risk, diagnosis or appropriate regimen without assessment. Local policies and patient preferences matter.

sources.title: Pressure ulcers: prevention and management (CG179), recommendations 1.1 and 1.3

claims.statement: NICE recommends skin assessment by a trained healthcare professional for adults assessed to be at high pressure-ulcer risk, including pressure-area skin integrity and changes in skin colour, heat, firmness and moisture.
claims.scope: Adults assessed to be at high risk of pressure ulcers.
claims.limitations: The recommendation is not an automatic finding of tissue injury. Assess risk and local clinical instructions; does not authorize any specific treatment.

sources.title: Pressure ulcers: prevention and management (CG179), recommendation 1.1.5
